source.author: cic
source.text: Atque isti quidem, qui docent, cum causas in plura genera secuerunt, singulis generibus argumentorum copiam suggerunt; quod etiam si ad instituendos adulescentulos magis aptum est, ut, simul ac posita causa sit, habeant quo se referant, unde statim expedita possint argumenta depromere, tamen et tardi ingeni est rivulos consectari, fontis rerum non videre, et iam aetatis est ususque nostri a capite quod velimus arcessere et unde omnia manent videre.
source.text_original: Atque isti quidem, qui docent, cum causas in plura genera secuerunt, singulis generibus argumentorum copiam suggerunt; quod etiam si ad instituendos adulescentulos magis aptum est, ut, simul ac posita causa sit, habeant quo se referant, unde statim expedita possint argumenta depromere, tamen et tardi ingeni est rivulos consectari, fontis rerum non videre, et iam aetatis est ususque nostri a capite quod velimus arcessere et unde omnia manent videre.
source.text_english: And those very people who teach, when they have divided cases into several classes, supply an abundance of arguments for each class; and although this is perhaps more suitable for instructing young men, so that as soon as a case has been proposed they may have a point to which to refer it and from which they may at once draw ready-made arguments, nevertheless it is the mark of a sluggish intellect to follow little streams and not see the sources of things, and it is now the part of our age and experience to fetch what we want from the head, and to see from where all things flow.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quorum exemplaria a supra dicto fratre poteris mutuari, licet tibi Graeca sufficiant et non debeas turbidos nostri ingenioli riuos quaerere, qui de ipsis fontibus bibis.
reuse.text_original: quorum exemplaria a supra dicto fratre poteris mutuari, licet tibi Graeca sufficiant et non debeas turbidos nostri ingenioli riuos quaerere, qui de ipsis fontibus bibis.
reuse.text_english: you can borrow copies of which from the brother mentioned above, though the Greek texts should be enough for you, and you ought not seek the muddied streams of our little talent, since you drink from the very springs themselves.
